Company profile

The ticker MBR.WA represents Mobilize Net SA, a Polish technology company listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. The enterprise specializes in the digital transformation sector, focusing on the provision of comprehensive IT solutions, software development, and modern mobile technologies for business clients. Originally established as a mobile marketing and solutions provider, the company has evolved over the years to adapt to the dynamic technological landscape, transitioning its core competencies toward advanced digital services and enterprise software development. Through its portfolio, Mobilize Net SA enables organizations to optimize their operational processes and enhance customer engagement strategies in an increasingly digital economy.
